title: Heihe riverfront, a few blocks around 中央街 and 母亲广场

origin.note: 母亲雕塑 / Скульптура матери, Heilongjiang Park, facing Blagoveshchensk

notes: Walkable streets are the Chinese bank: 中央街, 王肃街, 文化街, 海兰街, 兴安街 and the promenade.
The north bank of the Amur (黑龙江) is included as a visual skyline only.
Origin is the Mother sculpture so the plaza sits near (0, 0).
